task: Fix a squeaky floor or stairs
steps: Walk the area to pinpoint the exact squeaky board.
From above, drive a breakaway screw kit through the flooring into the joist below.
Snap off the screw head below the surface and fill with matching wax filler.
From below (if accessible), add a shim with wood glue between the subfloor and joist.
Test by walking over the spot again before patching visible holes.
